name: Final Defense Gender Switch Tool
description:
Can switch gender of defense equipment(Limit: Lvl. 12).

**How To Use**
When you select the defense equipment after clicking on this tool, the gender restriction will be changed.

**Restriction**
Usable when the item to change is in the inventory. Only items up to level 12 are eligible.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
